# FitProject

> A free, privacy-first gym workout log with Smart Rotation — adaptive routines built from your equipment, goals, and training history. Available on iOS. Android coming soon.

FitProject is a mobile workout app that lets users log workouts and receive adaptive routines based on their profile and training history. It is free to use with no subscription required. User data is never sold or shared.

## Core Features

- Workout logging: sets, reps, weight, rest periods, warm-up sets
- Smart Rotation: adaptive routines built from equipment, goals (strength/hypertrophy/endurance), weekly frequency (2-7 days), session duration (15-120 minutes), and training history. Rule-based engine that runs on-device; not AI
- Progress tracking: strength curves, personal records, weekly volume, active training time, weekly streaks
- Equipment configuration: dumbbells (with weight ranges), barbells (with plates), cables, bench, kettlebells, pull-up bar, and more — workouts only use equipment you have
- Reps in Reserve (RIR): effort tracking from max effort to very easy, used to adjust future workout suggestions
- Custom templates: create your own workouts, save completed sessions as templates, build custom weekly routines
- Workout splits: push, pull, lower body, upper body — auto-generated or custom

## Privacy

FitProject does not sell user data or share data with third parties. User workout data is private.

## Pricing

FitProject is free to use. There is no subscription required to access core features including workout logging and smart workout generation. It is a passion project built by an independent developer.

## Platforms
